turn.content: The invoice date is 2026-09-22. The contract clause KTR-V-027#11.1 raises the antivirus unit price to 415,800 only from 2026-10-04, and clause KTR-V-027#2.2 says changes are not retroactive. The invoice bills 415,800 on 2026-09-22, before that effective date; the PO price is 369,200.

tool_calls.name: submit_report
tool_calls.arguments: {"diagnoses": [{"issue_code": "price_mismatch", "line": 1, "cause": "contract_price_not_yet_effective", "evidence": [{"kind": "purchase_order", "ref": "PO-2026-0231", "detail": "PO unit price for Lisensi Antivirus 1 Tahun is 369,200"}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-027#11.1", "detail": "Addendum sets antivirus unit price to 415,800 only from 4 October 2026"}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-027#2.2", "detail": "Price changes apply only via written addendum and are not retroactive"}, {"kind": "invoice", "ref": "LST-26-00391", "detail": "Invoice date 2026-09-22, before the 2026-10-04 effective date, bills 415,800"}], "explanation": "The contract price of 415,800 is set by KTR-V-027#11.1 only with effect from 2026-10-04, so on the invoice date of 2026-09-22 the PO price of 369,200 still governs and the higher price is not yet effective."}]}
